R Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind issue Writs of Mandamus, directing the respondents herein to release the viz., 1774 Bags, viz., 106.440 Mts., of Betel Nut Product known as Supar (Unflavoured Supari) of Indonesia Origin imported from the Republic of Indonesia vide Bill of Entry No.7667102, dated 27.02.2022, classifiable Cth 21069030 and totally valued at Usd 159,660.00 for 106.440 MTs and further direct the respondents to issue Waiver Certificate for Detention Demurrage Charges under Regulations of Handling of Cargo in Customs Area Regulations 2009. For Petitioner : Mr.A.K.Jayaraj For Respondents : Mrs.M.Sheela Senior Standing Counsel R1 to R4 Mr.V.Sundareswaran, Senior Panel Counsel - R5 Order
texts.facts: . The petitioner seeks a mandamus directing the respondents to release the goods viz., 1774 Bags, viz., 106.440 Mts., of Betel Nut Product known as Supari (Unflavoured Supari) of Indonesia Origin imported from the Republic of Indonesia vide Bill of Entry No.7667102, dated 27.02.2022, classifiable under CTH 21069030 and totally valued at USD 159,660.00 for 106.440 MTs and further direct the respondents to issue Waiver Certificate for Detention and Demurrage Charges under Regulations of Handling of Cargo in Customs Areas Regulations 2009. texts.arguments: However, the provisions of Section 125, that deals with 'option to pay fine in view of confiscation' provides for two situations. 15. It is only in the case of other goods, that are not prohibited, that the Officer shall offer to the owner or the person from whose possession the goods were seized, an option to pay a fine, in lieu of confiscation.
